title: Formula for the variance-based Friedgut degree
statement: Let $f$ be a Boolean function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube, and suppose its variance is positive. Its Friedgut degree at error equal to one eighth of its variance is the ceiling of eight times its total influence divided by its variance.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a Boolean function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube
